blocks.orig: The Amboni Caves lie north of Tanga, on the north coast of Tanzania. This remarkable natural wonder exists of an extensive cave system dating back some 150 million years. The whole system is estimated to be 234 square kilometres in size, with stunning rock formations and ancient stalactites and stalagmites. Some caves are said to stretch for over a hundred kilometres! Dive into the depths of the one cave that is open to tourists, and discover the awe-inspiring beauty for yourself!
blocks.html: North of Tanga, on Tanzania's north coast, you find the Amboni Caves. This remarkable natural wonder consists of a vast cave system around 150 million years old. The entire system is thought to cover 234 square kilometres, full of stunning rock formations and ancient stalactites and stalagmites. Some of the caves are said to run for more than a hundred kilometres! Head deep into the one cave open to visitors and see its awe-inspiring beauty for yourself!
